1.dateLabel: Recorded 25 Feb 2026 · A Pact Beneath the Sun
1.startedHere: Emon, the city of wide stairs — Ayante and his master Diomedes arrive in Tal'Dorei by skyship and take in the city.
1.endedHere: Emon, just past noon — Ayante and Sorfon seal a pact hand-to-hand beneath the sun; Diomedes departs for Stilben and the two set out together.

ig.start: 26 Horisal 867 — arrival at Emon by skyship
ig.end: 26 Horisal 867 — just past noon, the pact is sealed

effects: Ayante has bound himself to Sorfon's quest, seeking his aristeia (his great deed).
Diomedes has left for Stilben, then Wildemount; Ayante is on his own from here.

activePlots.name: Plot A — Sorfon's Search
activePlots.qt: Sorfon, a Dwendalian knight and devotee of Pelor, has come to Tal'Dorei hunting an ancient temple. His mother is a priestess of Sarenrae's temple, where he was raised. Ayante, a fellow Pelor worshipper from Ilión, judged him worthy and swore to join his cause.

npcs.name: Sorfon's mother
npcs.role: a priestess of Sarenrae's temple, where Sorfon was raised

npcs.name: Emon
npcs.role: city of wide stairs and mahogany roofs

npcs.name: Sarenrae's faithful
npcs.role: the order Sorfon's mother served, tied to his search

npcs.name: Tal'Dorei
npcs.role: the far continent Ilión sent them to

notes: Sorfon seeks an ancient temple of Tal'Dorei; his mother served in the temple of Sarenrae.
Ayante speaks Zemnian; he overheard Sorfon speaking it with the mage Gilmore.
Two followers of Pelor, drawn together — Ayante read it as the god lighting two roads into one.
Diomedes must travel to the port of Stilben, then return to Wildemount.

activePlots.name: Plot B — Ayante's Aristeia
activePlots.qt: Ayante of Ilión was sent abroad with his master to help Ilión reach distant peoples, and to find his own aristeia — the great deed his city will remember. Everything he witnesses is to be written into a codex and delivered to Ilión.

npcs.name: The metrodidacts
npcs.role: the faction whose letter summoned Ayante and Diomedes abroad

npcs.name: Ilión
npcs.role: Ayante's austere homeland, whose people prize hardship and scorn luxury

npcs.name: Diomedes
npcs.role: Ayante's master, departing for Stilben then Wildemount

npcs.name: Damali
npcs.role: the port they sailed from into Tal'Dorei

notes: The codex records the journey for Ilión, so the city remembers what Ayante may forget.
Ayante seeks his aristeia and believes he may find it following Sorfon.
The pact was sealed by clasping bare arms beneath the noon sun, armor removed.
Ilión breeds hardness: the skyship's lavish cabin disgusted Ayante, though he endured it.

completedPlots.name: The Meeting at Gilmore's
completedPlots.qt: In Emon's academic district Ayante found Gilmore's shop, wreathed in magical fireworks. There the mage conjured floating hands to serve water, and Ayante overheard Sorfon asking after an ancient temple. Insults gave way to respect once Ayante learned Sorfon served Pelor, and after finding Diomedes the two sealed their pact.

npcs.name: Gilmore
npcs.role: friendly, deeply learned mage who runs the shop in the academic district

npcs.name: Gilmore's shop
npcs.role: ringed with magical fireworks, mage-hands serve water

npcs.name: Diomedes
npcs.role: found nearby, had already met Sorfon by chance on a bench

npcs.name: Academic district, Emon
npcs.role: felt desolate but for Gilmore's shop

notes: The academic district felt desolate; Gilmore's shop was the one lively spot.
Ayante mocked Sorfon's looks, then changed his mind on learning he served Pelor.
Diomedes had already met Sorfon by chance — Ayante saw the god's hand in it.
The farewell to Diomedes was bitter; they will not meet again for a long time.

2.dateLabel: Recorded 11 Mar 2026 · Ghosts of Greyskull Keep
2.startedHere: Emon, a small plaza near Greyskull Keep — Sorfon and Ayante outside as screams erupt from within the locked Keep; Mortis already inside following the Raven Queen's golden thread.
2.endedHere: Greyskull Keep, Emon — the party settled in for a long rest; two hours remain before Mortis's bind spell expires.

ig.start: 29 Horisal 867 — Emon, plaza near Greyskull Keep
ig.end: 29 Horisal 867 — night, Greyskull Keep (long rest taken)

effects: Mortis is bound to Sorfon's armor by Allura's bind spell — 2 hours remain before expiry.
Ereldra holds two books taken from the Keep's library: one ordinary, one malevolent.
Mortis found the Book of Baba Yaga; read some contents before it snapped shut — he cannot reopen it.
The party owes Allura a mission to repair the damage caused to Greyskull Keep.

activePlots.name: Plot A — Finding Pike / The Temple of Sarenrae
activePlots.qt: Sorfon's mother is devout to Sarenrae and trained at an ancient temple whose location is now lost. Pike Trickfoot is the only one who knows where it is. This session, Allura confirmed that Pike is currently in Issylra. Sorfon also contacted Sarenrae directly in the Keep's chapel — she is angered by his lifelong neglect of her, but offered a cryptic clue: 'The temple is just a temple; follow YOUR light.'

npcs.name: Sorfon's mother
npcs.role: devout of Sarenrae — trained at the lost ancient temple

npcs.name: Pike Trickfoot
npcs.role: cleric, currently in Issylra — only one who knows the temple's location

npcs.name: Allura Vysoren
npcs.role: archmage in Emon — confirmed Pike's location this session

npcs.name: Sarenrae
npcs.role: goddess of the dawn — contacted in Greyskull's chapel, angered, gave a cryptic clue

npcs.name: Temple of Sarenrae
npcs.role: lost ancient temple where Sorfon's mother trained — destination unknown

notes: Pike cannot be reached by magitech — must be found in person in Issylra.
Sarenrae is angered — Sorfon dedicated all prayers to Pelor and never prayed to her.
Sarenrae's clue: 'The temple is just a temple; follow YOUR light.'
Mortis recognized Sarenrae as the Eternal Light — an ally of the Raven Queen; her followers prize redemption.
Ayante struck Sorfon for praying to Sarenrae — served him a smaller portion at dinner.

activePlots.name: Plot B — The Raven Queen's Call
activePlots.qt: In a vision, the Raven Queen appeared to Mortis alongside the illusory image of a Vox Machina member currently in another plane — an emissary of the Raven Queen, connected by the golden thread. Before the vision ended, the Raven Queen warned: 'There is death in Kraghammer.' The golden thread led Mortis to Greyskull Keep.

npcs.name: The Raven Queen
npcs.role: Mortis's patron — appeared in vision alongside a Vox Machina emissary

npcs.name: Unknown Vox Machina member
npcs.role: in another plane — the Raven Queen's emissary, linked by the golden thread

npcs.name: Kraghammer
npcs.role: dwarven stronghold — death was foretold there by the Raven Queen

notes: The golden thread led Mortis specifically to Greyskull Keep.
The identity of the Vox Machina emissary is unknown.
The warning about Kraghammer has not yet been investigated.

activePlots.name: Plot C — The Book of Baba Yaga
activePlots.qt: While the party ate in the kitchen, Mortis slipped into the hallway and found a heavy tome pinned to a shelf by an axe. He pried it open and discovered it belongs to Baba Yaga — grandmother of all witches and the fey world's equivalent of the devil. The book deals in her curses. It snapped shut before he finished reading, and he cannot reopen it.

npcs.name: Baba Yaga
npcs.role: grandmother of all witches, the fey world's devil-equivalent — her tome is in Greyskull Keep

npcs.name: Greyskull Keep
npcs.role: the tome sits on a hallway shelf, axe embedded in the cover

notes: Mortis read some curse content before the book closed.
He cannot reopen it — unclear if physical or magical resistance.
Why is Baba Yaga's tome in Vox Machina's home? The axe holding it shut may be significant.

activePlots.name: Plot D — Debt to Allura / The Greyskull Mission
activePlots.qt: Allura Vysoren arrived to investigate the disturbance at Greyskull Keep, froze Mortis (revealing him as the apparent ghost), and proposed: the party stays for a day then undertakes a mission to repair the damages caused. The party is now Mortis's wardens.

npcs.name: Allura Vysoren
npcs.role: archmage, Greyskull Keep caretaker — key new contact

npcs.name: Greyskull Keep
npcs.role: Emon — the party's current lodging

notes: Bind spell linking Mortis to Sorfon cast by Allura — 6 hours total, 2 hours remain at session's end.
Allura asked: execute or imprison Mortis? Sorfon argued mercy, sensing he was an undead puppet not freely acting.
Mortis is approximately 300 years out of time — knew this continent as Gwessar (renamed Tal'Dorei ~300 years ago).
Nature of the repair mission is not yet revealed.

8.dateLabel: Recorded 25 Jun 2026 · The Vigil for Cassandra
8.startedHere: Kraghammer, in the ruins of the dwarven palace — moments after the dragon was driven off and Cassandra de Rolo fell. Mortis reaches out to her departing spirit.
8.endedHere: At the gates of Vasselheim after the airship crossing — magic items surrendered to the guard, the party racing to revive Cassandra before her soul is lost.

ig.start: 32 Horisal 867 — Kraghammer, just after the dragon

effects: Cassandra de Rolo's body lies in limbo — about 10 days remain to bring her back before her soul moves on.
Magic items surrendered at Vasselheim's gate; Sorfon carries Pelor's two talismans and now holds the title Emissary of Kraghammer.

activePlots.name: Bringing Cassandra Back
activePlots.qt: Cassandra de Rolo died to the ancient black dragon Haftifaflmorhen at Kraghammer, and her soul lingers in limbo for roughly ten days. The party must find someone able to cast a resurrection before the window closes. Mortis now knows the spell Speak with Dead exists but needs a teacher — his patron the Raven Queen, and the cleric Pike, are the most promising paths.

npcs.name: Cassandra de Rolo
npcs.role: deceased, soul in limbo — the party's charge

npcs.name: Pike Trickfoot
npcs.role: cleric who can revive her; cannot be reached by magitech, must be found in person

npcs.name: Percival 'Percy' de Rolo
npcs.role: King of Whitestone, Cassandra's brother — will not stop searching for a way

npcs.name: Vasselheim
npcs.role: walled city, the party's destination

notes: The carriage's communicator links to Percy; he confirmed the ~10-day limbo and that a true resurrection is far harder than hoped.
The Raven Queen, Mortis's patron, is named an ally in compassion for the resurrection effort.
Mortis must find a library or mage willing to teach Speak with Dead, or a scroll to copy.
Pelor confirmed the party is on the right path and will 'arrive before time.'

activePlots.name: Pelor's Charge
activePlots.qt: Pelor, god of the sun, spoke to Sorfon and set a sacred task: carry Pelor's incense from the Temple of Pelor in Vasselheim to the Temple of Sarenrae. Sorfon is also charged with protecting the surviving de Rolo family. Separately, Pelor asked Sorfon to test Ayante's worthiness before Ayante can reach the divine through him.

npcs.name: Pelor
npcs.role: god of the sun, Sorfon's deity — speaks through paired talismans and sunlight

npcs.name: Temple of Pelor
npcs.role: where the incense must be taken (it will not be easy to remove)

npcs.name: High Priestess of Pelor
npcs.role: give the phrase: 'The sacrament of Toro must manifest; the reunion must take place'

npcs.name: Temple of Sarenrae
npcs.role: where the incense must be delivered

notes: Sorfon must protect Percy and Cassandra, the surviving de Rolo family.
Ayante is not meant to hear the gods directly; Sorfon is his link, and must first put him to the test.
Pelor's short mantra was recited and accepted as a prayer.
Pelor will lend his aid the moment Cassandra is brought to safety.

activePlots.name: The Patron in the Hoard
activePlots.qt: During the airship crossing, the ancient red dragon Ashardalon — seated on a vast hoard — reached Ereldra through a vision, claiming to be her patron and demanding to know why the party had strayed from Whitestone. She professed loyalty, claiming she is earning Percy and Cassandra's trust to serve the patron's true objective, which is tied to the de Rolo family. A hidden agenda now runs beneath the rescue.

npcs.name: Ashardalon
npcs.role: Ereldra's ancient patron — fixated on Whitestone and the de Rolo line

npcs.name: Whitestone
npcs.role: the patron's true target

npcs.name: An ancient warlock founder
npcs.role: said to have split himself across the planes and founded the warlock order the party serves; reached by burning bones

npcs.name: Vasselheim
npcs.role: the gods' doors are closed and divine influence runs weak

notes: Ereldra was the one contacted — her eye turned catlike and clouded; the rest of the party treated it as an affliction to fight off.
The patron believes the objective lies with the de Rolo family, so keeping Percy and Cassandra close serves it.
Lore recalled: Umbrasyl and the fall of Westruun; Thornax, the red dragon who cratered Emon.
Vox Machina connections run through everything here — possible allies and dangers alike.

completedPlots.name: Delivering the Barûk-Kazad
completedPlots.qt: The party returned the legendary dwarven axe to Kraghammer and escorted Cassandra's body from the ruined palace. Both bounties — the axe to Kraghammer and Cassandra to Whitestone — were claimed for 4,800 gp total.

npcs.name: The Iron Fist of Kraghammer
npcs.role: Constructor General who rewarded the party

npcs.name: Kraghammer
npcs.role: ruined dwarven palace, now securing the Baruk under guard

npcs.name: A mechanical dwarf engineer
npcs.role: ~800 years old, bears a noble Kham house name

npcs.name: Whitestone
npcs.role: Cassandra's true destination

notes: The Barûk-Kazad will be kept under maximum security, out of sight, guarded around the clock.
Sorfon was named Emissary of Kraghammer — given ceremonial plate and a council seat (the 'Hang of Kham' honor).
Total reward: 4,800 gp (the Baruk bounty plus the Whitestone escort bounty).

10.startedHere: Pelor's chapel on the High Pass — the custodian hands over the sealed urn of incense while Mortis and Ereldra are still down in the crypt, standing over Caval's grave.
10.endedHere: A deep gnome trader's stall off the main avenue — a dead imp spy at their feet, the session ending mid-purchase as the Raven Queen's thread marks a Speak with Dead scroll.

ig.start: 38 Horisal 867 — ~3:00 PM, Pelor's chapel and the crypt
ig.rest: 38 Horisal 867 — that morning, aboard Percy's airship

effects: Deck of Many Things draws (~8 h): Sorfon +1 to attack and damage; Ereldra disadvantage on initiative; Ayante +2d10 maximum HP; Mortis holds three free castings of Knock.
Cassandra's body still has ~7 days of limbo; Mortis now holds the diamond.
Mortis and Ereldra have no pilgrim papers and risk expulsion from Vasselheim.
La Toma — the Slayer's Take — now knows Mortis is in the city.

activePlots.name: Plot A — Bringing Cassandra Back
activePlots.qt: Cassandra still has about seven days of limbo and Mortis holds the diamond. At a trader's stall a golden thread — the Raven Queen's mark — singled out a scroll of Speak with Dead, the spell Mortis has hunted since Kraghammer. A cleric who can actually cast the resurrection, Pike, is still missing.

npcs.name: Cassandra de Rolo
npcs.role: deceased, ~7 days of limbo left — wheeled through the city on the stretcher

npcs.name: Pike Trickfoot
npcs.role: the cleric who must cast the resurrection — still to be found

npcs.name: The gnome trader
npcs.role: sells scrolls, potions, alchemy kits and magical tattoos off the main avenue

npcs.name: Chapel of Pelor, High Pass
npcs.role: where the party chose to leave Cassandra's body

notes: A golden thread tied one scroll in the trader's stock: Speak with Dead, exactly what Mortis needs.
Also on offer: Cause Fear and Dust Devil scrolls at 100 gp each, five healing potions, tattoos at 200 gp.
Ubu offered his house for the body; the party refused (his mother and 11-year-old sister live there).
The session ended mid-purchase — the rest of the shopping is still open.

activePlots.name: Plot B — Pelor's Charge
activePlots.qt: The custodian handed over the incense at last. It must now be carried about 7 km across the city to the Temple of Sarenrae. Sorfon and Ayante swore to protect Pelor's sacred texts and hold pilgrim rights; the chapel is now their sworn house.

npcs.name: The custodian of Pelor's chapel
npcs.role: lone keeper and librarian of the sacred texts — oddly fit, a former abbey orphan

npcs.name: The censer of Pelor
npcs.role: sealed urn worked in silver with gold and copper, holding ash, kindling and an ivy

npcs.name: Temple of Sarenrae
npcs.role: about 7 km across the city — where the incense must be delivered

npcs.name: Chapel of Pelor, High Pass
npcs.role: now the party's sworn house, its sacred texts under their protection

notes: The incense smells of sandalwood, palo santo and pine; it stirred an old memory of Sorfon's youth.
The ivy sealed inside is a wound-healing herb that grows in beds near forest country.
Sorfon and Ayante hold pilgrim rights; Mortis and Ereldra still need theirs or risk expulsion.
Sorfon carries the censer; it hangs from a chain or rides in a pack.

activePlots.name: Plot C — Hunted and Watched
activePlots.qt: An invisible imp was riding at Ubu's feet, spying on the party. Smelling of brandy and sulfur, it broke under intimidation: its master is La Toma — the Slayer's Take — the monster-hunter guild quartered in the war district pavilion, and they are hunting Mortis. The party killed it, but a familiar can always be re-summoned. Separately, the white-robed man from the crossroads turned out to be the Archon of Bahamut.

npcs.name: La Toma (the Slayer's Take)
npcs.role: monster-hunter guild quartered in the war district pavilion — hunting Mortis

npcs.name: The Archon of Bahamut
npcs.role: bald and tall in white robes with silver and pale blue — the most powerful man in the city this cycle

npcs.name: Ubu
npcs.role: tall, good-natured guard of Bahamut who guided the party — oblivious to the imp at his feet

npcs.name: The war district pavilion
npcs.role: La Toma's seat, named by the imp under threat

notes: See Invisibility revealed the imp; Arcana (22) marked it a familiar used as a spying instrument.
Killed by launching it off a staff at speed and finishing it with Toll the Dead — it can be re-summoned.
Bahamut's faith governs Vasselheim this cycle; the Archon presides over the Congress on the central path.
Mortis was seen without his disguise; a guard read him as consecrated rather than desecrated.

completedPlots.name: Caval's Grave and the Witch's Book
completedPlots.qt: In the crypt Ereldra read the inscription over the grave — 'Here lies Caval' — and Mortis told her what he remembered of the betrayal. They agreed to keep it between them. Above ground the party finally argued out Baba Yaga's book and settled what to do with it.

npcs.name: Caval
npcs.role: Mortis's betrayer — his grave marked in the Low Pass crypt

npcs.name: Baba Yaga's book
npcs.role: bound in human skin, clasped with real teeth — foul fey magic

npcs.name: Allura
npcs.role: the debt owed to her comes before Mortis settles anything with Caval

npcs.name: The crypt, Low Pass
npcs.role: Caval's grave, its inscription written in a shadar-kai dialect

notes: The book: human-skin leather stitched with wire, calcified teeth for a clasp, a blood signature inside.
Burning it is worse than keeping it — a one-hour ritual returns it to Baba Yaga, who feels it destroyed.
Stowed in the bag of holding; Mortis promised to tell the party before ever opening it.
Mortis asked Ereldra to keep Caval secret; Sorfon and Ayante were not told.

11.startedHere: The deep gnome trader's stall off the main avenue — the last of the shopping done, a Deck of Illusions drawn, and Cassandra carried back up toward the High Pass.
11.endedHere: The palace gate at about four in the morning — Sorfon and Ereldra walk away from the Platinum Dragon, who would not take the axe off their hands.

ig.start: 38 Horisal 867 — late afternoon, the trader's stall
ig.rest: 38 Horisal 867 — that morning, aboard Percy's airship

effects: Cassandra has ~6 days of limbo left after the night's rest; the party now knows Pike Trickfoot can revive her, beneath the Temple of Sarenrae.

The Baxcazhak (Barûk) stays under guard in Kraghammer, but Ereldra can call it to her hand as her pact weapon — so the party is never truly without it. Bahamut refused to take it, and its whereabouts are revealed to no one.
Locus is bought free of La Toma for 200 gp, but the contract only lifts once their leader Ocisa (?) is dealt with; La Toma hunts Mortis and now Locus.
Locus is under a Geas — compelled, and hurt if he acts against it.
Holy water burns Ereldra; consecration reacts to her condition.
Sorfon still owes Pelor the incense-run to the Temple of Sarenrae, and must collect his new plate from Tyr in the morning.

activePlots.name: Plot A — Bringing Cassandra Back
activePlots.qt: Mortis prayed to the Raven Queen at the palace shrine, and her shadar-kai answered: Pike is beneath the Temple of Sarenrae and can use the diamond as a catalyst to restore Cassandra's soul. About six days of limbo remain.

npcs.name: Pike Trickfoot
npcs.role: the cleric who can cast the resurrection, found beneath the Temple of Sarenrae

npcs.name: Beneath the Temple of Sarenrae
npcs.role: where Pike is said to be

npcs.name: The shadar-kai of the Raven Queen
npcs.role: her hooded faithful, who located Pike for Mortis

npcs.name: The palace shrine of all gods
npcs.role: where Mortis reached her

notes: The diamond is a catalyst; a caster must drive it through Cassandra's chest to restore her soul.
Mortis lacks the spell himself; only a cleric like Pike can complete the rite.
~6 days of limbo remain after the night's rest.
Her priests reach her by dying willingly; Mortis is spared that.

activePlots.name: Plot B — Pelor's Charge
activePlots.qt: With the pilgrim rites done, the party left Cassandra's body in Pelor's chapel. Holy water splashed on Ereldra burned her. Sorfon still owes Pelor the incense-run to the Temple of Sarenrae, and must collect his armor from Tyr.

npcs.name: Marco
npcs.role: the lone custodian of Pelor's chapel, who granted the rites

npcs.name: Chapel of Pelor, High Pass
npcs.role: Cassandra's body laid on the third floor

npcs.name: Tyr the smith
npcs.role: holds Sorfon's new plate, ready the next morning

npcs.name: Temple of Sarenrae
npcs.role: where Pelor's incense must still be carried

notes: Holy water burned Ereldra — her condition reacts to consecration.
Sorfon swore again to protect Pelor's sacred texts while he lodges in the chapel.
Pilgrim papers only matter if a guard stops them; a shadar-kai phrase also lets Mortis pass.
Still to do: deliver the incense, collect Tyr's armor, reach Pike under Sarenrae's temple.

activePlots.name: Plot C — The Redeemed Dampir
activePlots.qt: La Toma caught a white-haired dampir named Locus in the crowd. Sorfon paid the 200 gp bounty to the orc Hungar (?) to claim him, meaning to redeem rather than kill him. Baba Yaga's book reveals Locus is the last living subject of a Strahd / Baba Yaga project to breed vampire monster-hunters, and that he is under a Geas.

npcs.name: Locus
npcs.role: white-haired half-vampire and blood-hunter, the last of his kind, under a Geas

npcs.name: The main avenue crowd
npcs.role: where La Toma seized Locus

npcs.name: Hungar (?)
npcs.role: bounty-hunter of La Toma, bear-cloaked and blood-eyed, paid off by Sorfon

npcs.name: The war-district enclave of La Toma
npcs.role: their seat, and their leader Ocisa (?)

notes: Sorfon paid 200 gp for Locus; the contract lifts only once La Toma's leader Ocisa (?) is dealt with.
Locus is under a Geas — compelled, and hurt if he acts against it (e.g. speaking of the book).
Baba Yaga's book: Locus is the sole survivor of a Strahd / Baba Yaga dampir blood-hunter line.
Sorfon means to redeem him; the plan is to slip him out of the city, away from La Toma.

activePlots.name: Plot D — The Axe and the Corrupted Dragon
activePlots.qt: Twice the ancient black dragon Haftifaflmorhen has appeared; the party learns why from Bahamut himself, met at the palace as the "Archon of Bahamut". Bahamut would not take the Baxcazhak (Barûk) off their hands — it stays under guard in Kraghammer, but Ereldra can summon it as her pact weapon, so the burden of it is still theirs and its whereabouts are told to no one.

npcs.name: Bahamut, the Platinum Dragon
npcs.role: met disguised as the "Archon", declined to take the axe

npcs.name: Haftifaflmorhen
npcs.role: the ancient black dragon, a corrupted victim who hunts the axe

npcs.name: Torog (?)
npcs.role: also heard as "Toro/Luto" — the betrayer who maddened Haftifaflmorhen, now sealed in his own plane

npcs.name: Cromulus (?)
npcs.role: Bahamut's old dragon companion, who withdrew after the Calamity

notes: Bahamut refused the axe; it stays in Kraghammer, Ereldra can summon it as her pact weapon, and no one is told where it lies.
Haftifaflmorhen was tricked by Torog (?) and forced to devour his best friend; he is a victim.
The axe should return to its maker (Moradin?); the peace only comes when it does.
Ereldra's patron is Ashardalon, whose plans would be served by the axe — another reason to keep it close.

completedPlots.name: The Meeting with Bahamut
completedPlots.qt: The white-robed man from the crossroads revealed himself as Bahamut, the Platinum Dragon. He explained that Haftifaflmorhen is a corrupted victim of Torog (?), refused to accept the Baxcazhak, and counselled the party to keep its location secret for now.

npcs.name: Bahamut, the Platinum Dragon
npcs.role: the "Archon" who governs Vasselheim this cycle

npcs.name: The palace gate
npcs.role: where Sorfon and Ereldra met him pre-dawn

npcs.name: Ereldra
npcs.role: present with Sorfon alone; she covered her cursed eye at his request

npcs.name: The high peak of the Calamity
npcs.role: where the Betrayers fought the Primes, as Bahamut recalled

notes: Bahamut declined the axe and said its location should stay hidden for now.
Haftifaflmorhen is Torog's (?) victim, driven mad and made to devour his best friend.
Bahamut and Cromulus (?) both fought in the Calamity; Cromulus withdrew, disillusioned, afterward.
He would not be handed the axe; the party leaves the palace still answerable for it, Ereldra's pact keeping it a summons away.
